scope: controlled design-partner beta only — NOT public self-service
decision_rationale: Worker is live and routes verified. Fail-closed auth, email, and scan gates are source-confirmed. Three NO_GO blockers remain that must be resolved before admitting design partners: (1) hosted D1 recovery posture unverified, (2) hosted alert delivery unverified, (3) hosted OAuth round-trip unverified. Five Medium-severity hosted-evidence gaps are recoverable during beta with documented workarounds.

NO_GO_items.title: D1 hosted recovery posture (backup cadence + restore rehearsal) unverified
NO_GO_items.continuation: Interactive terminal: bunx wrangler d1 info ARCH_DB --remote; bunx wrangler d1 backup list ARCH_DB --remote; perform preview-only restore drill (scripts/generate-cloudflare-d1-restore-rehearsal.ts is localOnly by design)

NO_GO_items.title: Hosted alert delivery for S-01..S-07 scenarios unverified
NO_GO_items.blocks: controlled beta admit (Philip cannot detect material failure)
NO_GO_items.continuation: Interactive terminal: confirm OPERATIONAL_INCIDENT_ALERTS_ENABLED=1 in Worker secrets; run each bun run ops:verify-observability-alert -- --scenario <name>

NO_GO_items.title: Hosted Google OAuth round-trip not exercised end-to-end
NO_GO_items.blocks: controlled beta admit (users cannot sign in)
NO_GO_items.evidence_blocked: requires a real test account; not authorized in this audit
NO_GO_items.continuation: Operator: drive login -> /api/auth/callback/google -> session cookie -> /workshop with a real test account; verify BETTER_AUTH_URL hosted secret is https://archestimator.com

CONDITIONAL_items.title: Email DNS posture (SPF/DMARC/DKIM) and inbound/outbound topology inconsistency
CONDITIONAL_items.rationale: Cohort can still sign in via Google OAuth; magic-link is the fallback and depends on email. Resolve before relying on magic-link or sending client-portal notifications.

CONDITIONAL_items.title: Cron-failure / missed-run hosted alert not wired
CONDITIONAL_items.rationale: Cron writes one cron_run_events row per branch (source-confirmed). Operator can manually inspect; auto-alert deferred.

CONDITIONAL_items.title: Hosted Workers Logs retention duration not pinned
CONDITIONAL_items.rationale: wrangler.jsonc has no explicit retention. Defaults apply. Pin retention before admitting cohort so incident reconstruction is possible.

CONDITIONAL_items.title: Live queue DLQ depth not inspected
CONDITIONAL_items.rationale: DLQs empty at start of beta (no traffic). Establish baseline and inspect cadence.

CONDITIONAL_items.title: Hosted deployment provenance (version/SHA) not captured
CONDITIONAL_items.rationale: Capture the deployment SHA at beta admit; Quality Master UNIT-002 will reconcile truthful CI claims separately.

GO_items_already_satisfied: Worker archestimator-proof is live at archestimator.com (HOSTED_CONFIRMED)
Auth route returns null for unauthenticated (fail-closed)
Sensitive routes (/api/internal/*) return 404 on apex (no unauthenticated internal surface)
HSTS preload + X-Frame-Options DENY + nosniff on auth route
Every cron branch writes exactly one cron_run_events row
